description: BFVZ PowerGantt Lite is a clean, fast Gantt chart for project teams who want a schedule on a Power BI page without a long setup. Bind Task Name, Start and Finish and the chart draws. Add a Group field for one level of phases or workstreams with summary bars, Task IDs and Predecessors for dependency lines and a computed critical path, Baseline Start and Finish for variance shading, and a Category field for color-coded bars with a legend. What you get: • Task bars with progress, one optional Group level with summary bars and expand/collapse • Baseline bars with slip and gain shading • Dependency lines (FS, SS, FF, SF with lag) and a computed critical path, with an optional bridged critical chain • Milestones from a Milestone Type field or zero-duration tasks • Data Date line (defaults to today), weekend shading, grid lines • Zoom from Year to Week with Ctrl + scroll, drag to pan, resizable task grid with Start, Finish, Duration and % columns • Category colors with a legend and multi-field tooltips • Schedule Health Check: 13 DCMA and GAO-aligned checks summarized per check • Light and dark themes, nine format cards, type sizes from 10 pt up • Up to 30,000 rows; no external connections, nothing leaves your tenant Works with data from Microsoft Project, Primavera P6, Excel, Planner, Jira, Smartsheet or any table with one row per task.
